title: Yes, bronze from anear, by gold from afar, heard steel from anear, hoofs ring from afar, and heard steelhoofs ringhoof ringsteel
html_source:
The two women are together yet different ie they display the characteristics of musical counterpoint – they rely on each other but are not the same. They heard sounds which were together but different.
